version-spec.create: @echo off set TAG={$$$ version $$$} git rev-parse -q --verify refs/tags/%TAG% >NUL 2>&1 && goto :exists git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin %TAG% >NUL 2>&1 && goto :exists git tag %TAG% git push origin main --tags exit /b 0 :exists echo ERROR: tag %TAG% already exists - run -vinc first exit /b 1

meta.description: Key/value pairs with any value for Go, kept in the order they came — Kv{K string; V any}, Lst []Kv and PtrLst, the Go side of the [["KEY", value], ...] JSON arrays exchanged with Xbase++ (ot4xb); keys are not normalized and may repeat; PeekValuesToLst/PeekValuesToMap pick values out by flags (case, repeats, not-found), VPeek gets one value (cast to the type of its default on request), Kv.Cast converts a value to a sample type with options (integers, floats, strings, dates, bool), and the pairs marshal to and from their JSON array form. Use when working with github.com/pablo-botella/kvany.
